title: Linear-algebra foundation for QGP Java port (ojAlgo + MTJ ArpackSym)
description:
**Blocker for PATCH-39 through PATCH-45.** Build the sparse-matrix + ILP plumbing the rest of the QGP pipeline runs on, using ojAlgo + MTJ ArpackSym (both pure Java, no native deps).

Responsibilities:
1. Add Maven deps: org.ojalgo:ojalgo (latest), com.googlecode.matrix-toolkits-java:mtj.
2. Wrappers under ixdar.geometry.mesh.qgp.solver/:
   - SparseMatrix (CSR + COO), with real and complex variants (complex via 2×2 real block lifting).
   - SparseLu — wraps ojAlgo SparseLU; refactor-and-resolve API for Bommes IGM.
   - SparseQDLDL wrapper (regularized Laplacian SPD-ish) — for KCPS via shift-invert.
   - GeneralizedEigen — ARPACK shift-invert Lanczos via MTJ's ArpackSym, calling SparseQDLDL as the inner solver.
   - IlpSolver — facade over ojAlgo ExpressionsBasedModel + IntegerSolver.
   - Predicates — robust geometry predicates (orient2d/3d).
3. STVD prerequisites (Campen Ch. 9): meta-graph builder for k-edge chains, plain Dijkstra on the meta-graph. Used by the cross-field stage and connectivity stage.

References:
- File plan: Ixdar/ixdar-tickets/PATCH-37-FILE-PLAN.md
- Algorithm spec: Ixdar/ixdar-tickets/PATCH-37-CAMPEN-SPEC.md (STVD section)
- ojAlgo survey result on PATCH-37 description
- metriko reference: /tmp/metriko/include/metriko/core/solver/ (~691 LOC C++)
definition-of-done: 1. SparseMatrix + SparseLU + SparseQDLDL pass tests on synthetic SPD/general systems (residual <1e-9). 2. GeneralizedEigen recovers known eigenvalues of a 1k-vertex Laplacian matching a Numpy reference. 3. IlpSolver solves a 100-variable mixed-integer program in under 1s. 4. STVD k=4 produces correct distances on the cube (vs. ground-truth analytic), within 5% of intrinsic distances. 5. All deps Maven-managed, no native libs added to ixdar-app.
testing-plan: 1. Unit tests in ixdar-app/src/test/java/ixdar/geometry/mesh/qgp/solver/ for each component. 2. SparseLU + SparseQDLDL: random SPD matrices, compare to dense LU/Cholesky residual. 3. GeneralizedEigen: known torus Laplacian, compare smallest eigenpair to closed form. 4. IlpSolver: textbook MIP test cases. 5. STVD: cube + flat plane synthetic tests against analytic geodesic distances.
